title: 语法 · 指代与一致｜代词和主语中心 · 60 句
description: 主宾格、物主、反身与相互、替代指代、不定代词、主谓一致及就近判断。

items.zh: 这份邀请是给我和我哥哥的。
items.en: The invitation is for my brother and me.
answers: The invitation is for my brother and me.
items.notes: 介词 for 后用宾格 me，不是 I。

items.zh: 是她而不是我提出了这个时间。
items.en: She, rather than I, suggested this time.
answers: She, rather than I, suggested this time.
items.notes: 主语位置用 she 和 I；rather than 短语不改变句子主语。

items.zh: 请把多出来的座位留给他们。
items.en: Please save the extra seats for them.
answers: Please save the extra seats for them.
items.notes: for 后接宾格 them，不能用 they。

items.zh: 我和他对音乐的喜好不一样。
items.en: He and I have different tastes in music.
answers: He and I have different tastes in music.
items.notes: 并列主语用主格；两人作主语用 have。

items.zh: 除了她以外，我们都尝过这种水果。
items.en: All of us except her have tasted this fruit.
answers: All of us except her have tasted this fruit.
items.notes: except 在此为介词，后接 her。

items.zh: 在你我之间，这只是一个猜测。
items.en: Between you and me, this is only a guess.
answers: Between you and me, this is only a guess.
items.notes: between 为介词，固定用 you and me。

items.zh: 老师让她和我负责接待。
items.en: The teacher put her and me in charge of reception.
answers: The teacher put her and me in charge of reception.
items.notes: 动词 put 的宾语用 her 和 me。

items.zh: 我认为他们比我们准备得充分。
items.en: I think they are better prepared than we are.
answers: I think they are better prepared than we are.
items.notes: 比较从句保留谓语 are 时，主语用 we。

items.zh: 给孩子讲故事的是我们，不是邻居。
items.en: We are the ones telling the children stories, not the neighbours.
answers: We are the ones telling the children stories, not the neighbours.
items.notes: we 作主语；the ones 指承担行为的人。

items.zh: 这件事关系到他，也关系到我们。
items.en: This concerns him as well as us.
answers: This concerns him as well as us.
items.notes: concern 为及物动词，两个对象均用宾格。

items.zh: 我的茶已经凉了，你的还冒着热气。
items.en: My tea is cold, but yours is still steaming.
answers: My tea is cold, but yours is still steaming.
items.notes: my 后接名词；yours 独立替代 your tea。

items.zh: 她借走了我的伞，因为她自己的伞坏了。
items.en: She borrowed my umbrella because hers was broken.
answers: She borrowed my umbrella because hers was broken.
items.notes: hers 为物主代词，不能再接 umbrella。

items.zh: 这条围巾不是我们的，是那位歌手的。
items.en: The scarf is not ours; it belongs to the singer.
answers: The scarf is not ours; it belongs to the singer.
The scarf isn't ours; it belongs to the singer.
items.notes: ours 独立作表语；belong to 表所属。

items.zh: 他们的花园比我们的长，但更窄。
items.en: Their garden is longer than ours but narrower.
answers: Their garden is longer than ours but narrower.
items.notes: their 为物主限定词，ours 替代 our garden。

items.zh: 我们都带了自己的水瓶。
items.en: We all brought our own water bottles.
answers: We all brought our own water bottles.
items.notes: our own 回指 we，强调每人带自己的物品。

items.zh: 这家餐馆以它自己的面包闻名。
items.en: The restaurant is known for its own bread.
answers: The restaurant is known for its own bread.
items.notes: its 为物主限定词，不写 it's。

items.zh: 我父母的房间在楼上。
items.en: My parents' room is upstairs.
answers: My parents' room is upstairs.
items.notes: 复数 parents 已有 s，所有格只加撇号。

items.zh: 孩子们的外套都挂在门边。
items.en: The children's coats are hanging by the door.
answers: The children's coats are hanging by the door.
items.notes: children 为不规则复数，所有格用 children's。

items.zh: 这是我姐姐的一位老朋友送的礼物。
items.en: This is a gift from an old friend of my sister's.
answers: This is a gift from an old friend of my sister's.
items.notes: a friend of someone's 为双重所有格。

items.zh: 一小时的步行让我们都饿了。
items.en: An hour's walk made us hungry.
answers: An hour's walk made us hungry.
items.notes: 时间名词可用 's 表度量修饰。

items.zh: 我不是让你替我道歉，我会自己道歉。
items.en: I am not asking you to apologise for me; I will do it myself.
answers: I am not asking you to apologise for me; I will do it myself.
items.notes: myself 强调本人执行，不代替主格 I。

items.zh: 她在镜子里看着自己，试着露出儿时照片中的笑容。
items.en: She looked at herself in the mirror and tried to copy her childhood smile.
answers: She looked at herself in the mirror and tried to copy her childhood smile.
items.notes: herself 作 at 的宾语，回指主语 she。

items.zh: 请随意取用桌上的水果。
items.en: Please help yourself to the fruit on the table.
answers: Please help yourself to the fruit on the table.
items.notes: help yourself to：请自取食物。

items.zh: 我们不必把所有责任都揽到自己身上。
items.en: We need not take all the responsibility on ourselves.
answers: We need not take all the responsibility on ourselves.
We needn't take all the responsibility on ourselves.
items.notes: ourselves 回指主语 we，不是其他人。

items.zh: 两位选手比赛结束后互相祝贺。
items.en: The two players congratulated each other after the match.
answers: The two players congratulated each other after the match.
items.notes: each other 表双方相互，不是 each themselves。

items.zh: 他对自己说，再试一次就停。
items.en: He told himself to try once more and then stop.
answers: He told himself to try once more and then stop.
items.notes: tell oneself：对自己说，主宾为同一人。

items.zh: 我独自去看了那场演出。
items.en: I went to the performance by myself.
answers: I went to the performance by myself.
items.notes: by myself：独自，与 myself 的强调功能区分。

items.zh: 这些照片本身并不能解释争议。
items.en: The photographs themselves do not explain the dispute.
answers: The photographs themselves do not explain the dispute.
The photographs themselves don't explain the dispute.
items.notes: themselves 为强调同位成分，去掉不影响句子骨架。

items.zh: 我们为自己争取到了讨论的机会。
items.en: We secured ourselves a chance to discuss the issue.
answers: We secured ourselves a chance to discuss the issue.
items.notes: ourselves 为受益者，与主语相同。

items.zh: 两只猫在门口互相闻了闻。
items.en: The two cats sniffed each other at the door.
answers: The two cats sniffed each other at the door.
items.notes: each other 表相互行为，不是各闻自己。

items.zh: 我不想要带花纹的杯子，素色的就好。
items.en: I do not want the patterned cup; a plain one will do.
answers: I do not want the patterned cup; a plain one will do.
I don't want the patterned cup; a plain one will do.
items.notes: one 替代可数单数 cup，避免重复。

items.zh: 红色的苹果比绿色的更软。
items.en: The red apples are softer than the green ones.
answers: The red apples are softer than the green ones.
items.notes: ones 替代可数复数 apples。

items.zh: 这家店的价格比车站那家的低。
items.en: The prices here are lower than those at the station shop.
answers: The prices here are lower than those at the station shop.
items.notes: those 替代 prices，保持比较对象同类。

items.zh: 今年的降雨量高于去年的。
items.en: This year's rainfall exceeds that of last year.
answers: This year's rainfall exceeds that of last year.
items.notes: that 替代不可数 rainfall，不用 one。

items.zh: 请用深一点的碗，浅的装不下这份汤。
items.en: Use a deeper bowl; the shallow one cannot hold this much soup.
answers: Use a deeper bowl; the shallow one cannot hold this much soup.
Use a deeper bowl; the shallow one can't hold this much soup.
items.notes: the shallow one 替代已知的浅碗；one 指可数单数。

items.zh: 我更喜欢这位作家的早期作品。
items.en: I prefer this writer's earlier works to the later ones.
answers: I prefer this writer's earlier works to the later ones.
items.notes: ones 替代 works，保留 later 的对比。

items.zh: 现场录音的质量不如录音室版本。
items.en: The quality of the live recording is below that of the studio version.
answers: The quality of the live recording is below that of the studio version.
items.notes: that 替代 quality，避免把质量与版本本身比较。

items.zh: 这些路线中，有没有适合儿童的？
items.en: Are any of these routes suitable for children?
answers: Are any of these routes suitable for children?
items.notes: any 独立指其中若干，不必重复 routes。

items.zh: 一辆车给游客使用，另一辆留给工作人员。
items.en: One vehicle is for visitors; the other is for staff.
answers: One vehicle is for visitors; the other is for staff.
items.notes: 明确两辆时用 one ... the other。

items.zh: 有些照片模糊了，其他的仍可以使用。
items.en: Some photographs are blurred; the others are still usable.
answers: Some photographs are blurred; the others are still usable.
items.notes: the others 指已知集合中其余全部。

items.zh: 谁都可以提出意见，但每个人都需要说明理由。
items.en: Anyone may comment, but everyone needs to give a reason.
answers: Anyone may comment, but everyone needs to give a reason.
items.notes: everyone 单数，谓语用 needs。

items.zh: 每位乘客都能调节自己的阅读灯。
items.en: Each passenger can adjust their reading light.
answers: Each passenger can adjust their reading light.
items.notes: each passenger 为单数；性别未知的个人可用 their 回指。

items.zh: 没有人知道自己的名字会被先叫到。
items.en: Nobody knows whose name will be called first.
answers: Nobody knows whose name will be called first.
items.notes: nobody 作单数主语，knows 加 s。

items.zh: 任何有疑问的人都可以来问我。
items.en: Anyone with questions is welcome to ask me.
answers: Anyone with questions is welcome to ask me.
items.notes: with questions 不改变 anyone 的单数属性。

items.zh: 两位见证人都在协议上签了名。
items.en: Both witnesses have signed the agreement.
answers: Both witnesses have signed the agreement.
items.notes: both + 复数名词；助动词用 have 而不是 has。

items.zh: 两条建议都没有解决座位不足的问题。
items.en: Neither suggestion addresses the shortage of seats.
answers: Neither suggestion addresses the shortage of seats.
items.notes: neither + 单数名词，谓语 addresses。

items.zh: 这份名单上的每个人都已获通知。
items.en: Everyone on this list has been notified.
answers: Everyone on this list has been notified.
items.notes: 介词短语不影响 everyone 的单数一致。

items.zh: 有人把外套落在这里了，但我们不知道是谁。
items.en: Someone has left a coat here, but we do not know who.
answers: Someone has left a coat here, but we do not know who.
Someone has left a coat here, but we don't know who.
items.notes: someone 单数，has；who 可省略可恢复的谓语。

items.zh: 大多数面包已经切好了。
items.en: Most of the bread is sliced.
answers: Most of the bread is sliced.
items.notes: most of 后 bread 不可数，所以用 is。

items.zh: 大多数面包卷已经售出。
items.en: Most of the rolls are sold.
answers: Most of the rolls are sold.
items.notes: most of 后 rolls 可数复数，所以用 are。

items.zh: 茶杯的数量不影响我们需要多少张桌子。
items.en: The number of cups does not determine how many tables we need.
answers: The number of cups does not determine how many tables we need.
The number of cups doesn't determine how many tables we need.
items.notes: the number of 主语中心 number 单数，does。

items.zh: 有几位客人希望换到户外。
items.en: A number of guests wish to move outside.
answers: A number of guests wish to move outside.
items.notes: a number of 意为一些，谓语随 guests 用复数。

items.zh: 那篮苹果闻起来很香。
items.en: The basket of apples smells sweet.
answers: The basket of apples smells sweet.
items.notes: 主语中心 basket 单数，不随 apples 用 smell。

items.zh: 每张椅子和每张桌子都需要贴标签。
items.en: Every chair and every table needs a label.
answers: Every chair and every table needs a label.
items.notes: every ... and every ... 逐个看待，谓语用单数。

items.zh: 不是主人，就是两位助手负责关门。
items.en: Either the host or the two assistants are responsible for locking up.
answers: Either the host or the two assistants are responsible for locking up.
items.notes: either ... or ... 通常就近一致，assistants 对应 are。

items.zh: 两位助手和主人一起负责登记。
items.en: The two assistants, together with the host, handle registration.
answers: The two assistants, together with the host, handle registration.
items.notes: together with 不构成并列主语，handle 随 assistants。

items.zh: 散步和游泳都是她喜欢的活动。
items.en: Walking and swimming are activities she enjoys.
answers: Walking and swimming are activities she enjoys.
items.notes: 两个不同活动作并列主语，谓语复数。

items.zh: 坐在窗边对他来说很重要。
items.en: Sitting beside a window matters to him.
answers: Sitting beside a window matters to him.
items.notes: 动名词短语整体作单数主语，用 matters。

items.zh: 每一份反馈，包括匿名意见，都有参考价值。
items.en: Every response, including anonymous feedback, has value.
answers: Every response, including anonymous feedback, has value.
items.notes: including 短语不改变 every response 的单数。

items.zh: 离入口十米远对这位老人来说已经太远。
items.en: Ten metres from the entrance is too far for this elderly visitor.
answers: Ten metres from the entrance is too far for this elderly visitor.
items.notes: 距离作为一个整体概念，谓语用 is。
